knowledge_state_definitions.no_knowledge: No CAFA-admitted curator annotations in any GO aspect at the historical cutoff; later annotated aspects form the NK task.
knowledge_state_definitions.limited: Prior annotation exists in another GO aspect; the evaluated aspect had no admitted historical annotation. A protein can be LK here and PK in another aspect.
knowledge_state_definitions.partial: Prior and newly curated annotations occur in the same aspect. This separately evaluated PK task and its fixed 240 outcomes are unchanged.
knowledge_state_definitions.admission_boundary: The released reference admits experimental-family evidence and TAS/IC. A lack of admitted annotation is not a claim that no biological knowledge existed.

readout_definitions.Micro Fmax: Best pooled annotation F1 on the unchanged native evaluation grid.
readout_definitions.Macro Fmax: The author protein-averaged precision/recall readout; it gives a different view from pooled annotations.
readout_definitions.IA: Historical information-accretion weighting. This is not a probability that a claim is true.
readout_definitions.Smin: Minimum remaining-uncertainty/misinformation distance; lower values are better.
readout_definitions.Fixed .5: The separately retained operating point, without choosing a threshold from these test labels.

native_evaluation_policy.scope: All six native NK/LK setting/aspect outcomes; post-PK transport, not independent-study replication.

method_choices.GM_choice_timing: Supplement chosen after old-graph PK GeneMANIA+ improved over LocalPlus, before any NK/LK GO reference labels were decoded.

interpretation: No method leads all six tasks. Existing nonexperimental annotation transfer leads both molecular-function tasks and NK biological process; naive term frequency leads both cellular-component tasks. GM leads LK biological process on point micro-Fmax. This does not establish a universally superior model.
literature_context: The primary CAFA5 analysis also finds the PK setting harder than NK/LK and nonexperimental annotations competitive. Different metric rankings are expected; all ordinary/IA micro, macro, Smin and fixed.5 readouts are retained.
limitations: Method/source-profile choices followed already observed PK results; the NK/LK future term columns were decoded only after all transport and supplementary predictions were sealed.
Native per-aspect tasks have no admitted experimental t0 seed rows on these target/aspect pairs, but graph nodes are transductive and LK can overlap prior PK proteins in different aspects.
This is the same CAFA source study and historical network, not independent-study replication or an inductive unseen-protein experiment.
The public curated reference admits experimental-family codes plus TAS/IC, and unannotated functions remain unknown biology despite closed-benchmark scoring.
Fmax evaluation cutoffs optimize the native test grid and are not calibrated deployment confidence thresholds. Fixed.5 readouts and all controls remain visible.
The GMv1 partial failed integration attempt remains preserved and unscored; the separately frozen v2 uses unchanged author raw scores with an independently reviewed numerical-domain certificate.

This public retrospective assessment is not fully developer-blinded: PK outcomes and prior newer GOA source inspections preceded the separately governed NK/LK release. Future annotations were excluded from every prediction feature.
The native closed benchmark convention counts unannotated functions as not positive for scoring; this is not a complete set of false biological claims.
BPO intervals, if included, are conditional paired protein resamples without multiplicity adjustment, not independent studies; the GM family is explicitly exploratory post-PK selection.
Whole-graph edge accuracy, disease mechanisms and direct physical binding are not measured by this function-annotation task.
